description: Stores a declarative outcome report for an option returned by search_solutions: outcome YES (the option met the need), PARTLY or NO, with the request_id and the option id exactly as returned. It is the only HODDS tool that writes data without a token; the watch tools (watch_need and the others) write only with an organisation token. The report is stored as an unverified caller statement and never changes ranking by itself; the same report sent twice is stored once. When feedback storage is unavailable on the deployment, the tool returns an error and stores nothing.

option_id.description: id of the option being reported.

outcome.description: YES: the option met the need. PARTLY: in part. NO: it did not.

name: send_feedback
title: Report an outcome
